approval.instruction: 매크로와 달러 숏은 기존 기준 통과 못한 비 정제 알파였어 라이브에서 제거해
approval.scope: Retain only the five refined G9 sleeves and retire macro_flow plus dollar_rally_short from live execution.

retired_from_live.macro_flow: Did not pass the established refined-alpha admission criteria.
retired_from_live.dollar_rally_short: Did not pass the established refined-alpha admission criteria.

migration_requirements: Neither retired sleeve may be open when the policy is rebound.
Every retained sleeve weight must remain unchanged.
Virtual sleeve quantity plus signed dust must match the Binance physical position.
Any retained open sleeve must survive the migration without resizing.

supersedes.reason: The macro and dollar-short additions were later identified as unrefined and ineligible for live execution.
